futures_welfare_coupon_use:
1. To view your deduction coupons, 
KuCoin Thailand Futures website: Assets > Asset Overview. 
KuCoin Thailand app: Futures > Upper-right corner > Deduction Coupon.
2. Futures Deduction Coupons are automatically applied when users conduct futures trades. Fees will first be charged, then the deducted amount will be refunded into your Futures Account. For Coin-Margined contracts, refunds will be calculated based on the real-time exchange rates and be issued in USDT.
3. The system will automatically select available deduction coupons for use in the following order: Highest deduction ratio > Least number of days remaining > Previously used > Highest total face value.
4. Only one deduction coupon can be used per trade. Each deduction coupon can be used for multiple trades as long as it still has remaining unused amounts and has not yet expired.

margin_index_cc_rule_eg:
Example A:
For BTC, suppose the prices taken for the index are from KuCoin Thailand, Binance, and OKX. At a point in time, the collected prices are 40,000 USDT, 41,000 USDT, and 39,000 USDT each. As there are an odd number of components (three), the median value is used. As such, the spot index price for BTC is 40,000 USDT.

Example B:
Suppose that this time, for BTC, the prices taken for the index are from KuCoin Thailand, Binance, OKX, and Coinbase. At a point in time, the collected prices are 40,000 USDT, 41,000 USDT, 39,000 USDT, and 42,000 USDT each. As there are an even number of components (four), the average of the middle two values is used. As such, the spot index price for BTC is: (40,000 + 41,000) ÷ 2 = 40,500 USDT.

payment_p2p_tips:
1. Beyond the buyer's own proof of payment, always log into your account to confirm that the funds have indeed arrived.

2. Protect your cryptocurrency vigilantly! Screenshots from buyers aren't always reliable. Always verify payment in your bank or wallet before transferring any cryptocurrency.

3. Certain payment methods can take up to 1–3 days for the funds to show up in your account. If your payment is still processing, always wait for confirmation before releasing any tokens.

4. Avoid accepting payments from suspicious third parties. If you happen to receive any, it's best to refund it immediately. Such payments can be reversed, leading to potential losses should you release your tokens prematurely.

5. Important: Any transactions on KuCoin Thailand will only be communicated through official emails, the online platform, or authorized third parties for asset management and dispute resolution. All other requests from unofficial channels asking you to send or disclose your tokens should be treated with suspicion. Always confirm that you've received payment before releasing your tokens. Stay alert and keep your assets safe.
